conditions.description: The explicitly selected work is closed, and related fork, resume and publication operations have finished; this includes selected-thread metadata updates. Unrelated work may continue.
The selected rollout locations and every affected database and log location use the qualified local filesystem and cooperative writer and SQLite locks.
No NFS or cross-host filesystem behavior is covered, and no offline database cutover or arbitrary operator replacement may run concurrently.
A catalogue activity label, age or a writer-lock observation alone does not certify quiescence; exact native ownership and fresh execution checks remain required.
This scoped assessment does not certify historical-body integrity, a complete Core lifecycle, generic Rust equivalence or the source and signature of an observed producer binary.

Relevant local source, caller and generated-input effects were reviewed within the declared scope; external implementation, compiler, feature-matrix and runtime configuration equivalence are not established.
Only qualified owner, provider, attachment and Guardian representations are covered; unsupported Internal Guardian selections remain protected or refused.
This record does not establish producer binary identity, verify its own origin, prove current quiescence or authorize a cleanup operation.

The actual producer and helper use matching qualified roots for the state database, companion databases, logs and selected rollout locations. Neither this record nor the helper request independently observes that the producer uses those locations.
Ordinary cache, plugin, process and output paths do not alias selected storage locations.
